name: event_velocity
derivation: Number of events divided by total session duration in hours

name: distinct_ctmc_states
derivation: Unique count of CTMC transition states observed in session

name: avg_time_between_events
derivation: Average delta seconds between sequential events

name: max_time_between_events
derivation: Maximum delta seconds between sequential events

name: file_access_count
derivation: Count of events exactly matching File_Access

name: file_delete_count
derivation: Count of events exactly matching File_Delete

name: file_modify_count
derivation: Count of events exactly matching File_Modify

name: file_add_count
derivation: Count of events exactly matching File_Add

name: auth_success_count
derivation: Count of events exactly matching Login

name: auth_fail_count
derivation: Count of events exactly matching Login_Failed

name: privilege_escalation_count
derivation: Count of events exactly matching Privilege_Command

name: suspicious_cmd_count
derivation: Count of events exactly matching Suspicious_Command

name: off_hours_event_ratio
derivation: Percentage of events occurring outside 07:00-20:00 window

name: weekend_event_ratio
derivation: Percentage of events occurring on Saturday/Sunday

name: burst_event_count
derivation: Number of events firing with < 2s delta

name: distinct_action_types
derivation: Unique literal sub-actions extracted from raw event
